decision_cruda.rationale: LH-10 is idle at the taller, so lending it costs nothing. It reaches E569-07 in 0.49 h and loads at 27.5 t/h on 10.5 g/t ore, about 9.3 oz/h. Este is not truck-limited (stockpile 48 t, trucks 72 t/h, inflow 0). That stope's repair is likely 13:30 (range 12:30 to 14:30). Only 164 t is left there. The loan therefore gains about 10 t (3 oz) if repair is on time and about 68 t (23 oz) at the high estimate, so I expect about 12 oz. I did not cover C512-04: it holds 238 t at 5.8 g/t, LH-06 is likely back at 11:30 with time to finish it, and a loan from the LH-08 heading would cost 1.3 oz/h for little gain. No reserves can be activated because no stope is stopped. Radio and CMMS agree on both failures.
